Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Per our discussion I attached the latest Mutual Action Plan (MAP_draft_v1.pdf) — see the milestones we agreed on and the proposed target close date of 2025-07-31. Key items we flagged that need alignment:

- Legal review / MSA & DPA redlines (owner: Acme legal + Redwood to coordinate)
- Technical evaluation (PoC/test account provisioning) — owner: Acme dev team / Redwood infra
- Security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence) — owner: Acme (questions) / Redwood to supply artifacts

Next steps I propose:
1) Samantha to send Acme's legal redlines to us (we'll track in the MAP).
2) Redwood legal (cc'd: Dev) to confirm who will own edits in the source MSA and turnaround expectations.
3) Marissa to update MAP with milestone owners and push for sign by 2025-07-31.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (attached).

Cheers,

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. Attaching Acme's initial redlines for the MSA and comments on the DPA (Acme_MSA_redlines_v1.docx, Acme_DPA_comments.pdf). A couple of questions for clarity so we can keep to your 7/31 target:

- Who on the Redwood side will be the primary owner for accepting/rejecting our redlines?

Proposed Redwood response:
- Redwood legal (Dev Patel) will be the primary owner for consolidating edits on the MSA/DPA.

- Final execution timeline: target sign-off by 2025-07-31 assuming 1-2 rounds of negotiation.

Dependencies: we may need input from Product on two SLA clauses (latency & availability) — Logan, can you flag any non-negotiable commitments and provide baseline numbers? Also, if Acme insists on custom language for data residency, we may need additional time.

Can you confirm (Dev + Logan) so I can reply to Samantha and update the MAP?

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa / Samantha / Carlos —

Thanks for the ping and for the attachments. Confirming Redwood legal will own the consolidation and initial edits for MSA & DPA. Our proposed plan:

1) Redwood legal (Dev Patel) will do the first consolidated pass and return a single tracked-changes doc to Acme.
2) Turnaround: initial consolidated comments within 48 business hours of receiving redlines (we'll expedite smaller items sooner).
3) SLA baseline: Product (Logan) to provide recommended SLA language by end of day Mon 7/14; if Acme has specific numerical targets outside our standard, that may require engineering sign-off and could extend the timeline.
4) If there are material DPA changes (data residency, deletion timelines) we'll flag and propose a short 3-5 business day review window with our security leads.

Samantha — please confirm if 48 business hours works for Acme as well, and whether you prefer consolidated tracked-changes or inline comments. Once confirmed I'll schedule the first pass and target returning consolidated redlines by EOD Mon 7/14 (assuming no additional dependency delays).

Best,
